description:
Title: Contract

For your contract project you need parts from several web shops.
In order to find out which web shop has the right parts, you have to query them all, and find out how much they can deliver, at which price, and how long it will take.
Create a list of parts that you order from each shop.
If one shop has not enough  parts, order from several shops.
Always use the cheapest parts.
The parts arrive in batches in a random order, typically they are +/- 2 days earlier/later.
When the first parts arrive you start building.
Sometimes you have to reorder parts.
If your stock (for a single part) falls below 5, you reorder (the cheapest), if it falls below 3 you reorder again (the fastest).
If it is zero, you write a mail to your friends, complaining about the webshops.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/contract">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ShopInquiry" name="Shop inquiry"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ShopInformation" name="Availability, price, and delivery time"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PartsOrder" name="Parts order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PartsBatch" name="Parts batch"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_FriendEmail" name="Complaint email to friends"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Contract" name="Contract" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Contract" name="Contract project starts">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Query</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_QueryShops" name="Query all web shops" messageRef="Message_ShopInquiry">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Query</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Query_ReceiveInfo</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveShopInfo" name="Receive quantities, prices, and delivery times" messageRef="Message_ShopInformation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Query_ReceiveInfo</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReceiveInfo_SupplyGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Supply" name="Can one shop supply the required quantities?" default="Flow_Supply_No">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReceiveInfo_SupplyGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Supply_Yes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Supply_No</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ListSingleShop" name="List parts from the cheapest suitable shop">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Supply_Yes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Single_ListMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ListMultipleShops" name="List parts from several shops using the cheapest parts">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Supply_No</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Multiple_ListMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ListMerge" name="Shop-specific parts lists prepared">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Single_ListMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Multiple_ListMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ListMerge_PlaceOrder</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_PlaceOrders" name="Place parts orders from the lists" messageRef="Message_PartsOrder">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ListMerge_PlaceOrder</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PlaceOrder_FirstBatch</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_FirstBatch" name="First parts batch arrives">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PlaceOrder_FirstBatch</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FirstBatch_StartBuilding</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDef_FirstBatch" messageRef="Message_PartsBatch"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_StartBuilding" name="Start building">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FirstBatch_StartBuilding</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StartBuilding_Build</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuildUseParts" name="Build using available parts">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StartBuilding_Build</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_LaterBatch_Build</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Build_CheckStock</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckStock" name="Check stock for each part">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Build_CheckStock</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CheckStock_Below5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Below5" name="Is any single part's stock below 5?" default="Flow_Below5_No">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CheckStock_Below5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Below5_Yes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Below5_No</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReorderCheapest" name="Reorder the part from the cheapest shop" messageRef="Message_PartsOrder">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Below5_Yes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReorderCheapest_Below3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Below3" name="Is any single part's stock below 3?" default="Flow_Below3_No">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReorderCheapest_Below3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Below3_Yes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Below3_No</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReorderFastest" name="Reorder the part from the fastest shop" messageRef="Message_PartsOrder">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Below3_Yes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReorderFastest_ZeroMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ZeroMerge" name="Reorders for the stock thresholds assessed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Below5_No</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Below3_No</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReorderFastest_ZeroMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ZeroMerge_Zero</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Zero" name="Is any single part's stock zero?" default="Flow_Zero_No">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ZeroMerge_Zero</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Zero_Yes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Zero_No</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ComplainByEmail" name="Email friends to complain about the web shops" messageRef="Message_FriendEmail">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Zero_Yes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Email_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ComplaintSent" name="Complaint email sent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Email_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_LaterBatch" name="Another parts batch arrives">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Zero_No</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_LaterBatch_Build</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDef_LaterBatch" messageRef="Message_PartsBatch"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Query" sourceRef="Start_Contract" targetRef="Task_QueryShops"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Query_ReceiveInfo" sourceRef="Task_QueryShops" targetRef="Task_ReceiveShopInfo"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveInfo_SupplyGateway" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveShopInfo" targetRef="Gateway_Supply"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Supply_Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Supply" targetRef="Task_ListSingleShop">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">oneShopCanSupplyRequiredQuantities</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Supply_No" sourceRef="Gateway_Supply" targetRef="Task_ListMultipleShops"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Single_ListMerge" sourceRef="Task_ListSingleShop" targetRef="Gateway_ListMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Multiple_ListMerge" sourceRef="Task_ListMultipleShops" targetRef="Gateway_ListMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ListMerge_PlaceOrder" sourceRef="Gateway_ListMerge" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrders"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PlaceOrder_FirstBatch" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrders" targetRef="Event_FirstBatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FirstBatch_StartBuilding" sourceRef="Event_FirstBatch" targetRef="Task_StartBuilding"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartBuilding_Build" sourceRef="Task_StartBuilding" targetRef="Task_BuildUseParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Build_CheckStock" sourceRef="Task_BuildUseParts" targetRef="Task_CheckStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckStock_Below5" sourceRef="Task_CheckStock" targetRef="Gateway_Below5"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Below5_Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Below5" targetRef="Task_ReorderCheapest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">anySinglePartStockBelow5</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Below5_No" sourceRef="Gateway_Below5" targetRef="Gateway_ZeroMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReorderCheapest_Below3" sourceRef="Task_ReorderCheapest" targetRef="Gateway_Below3"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Below3_Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Below3" targetRef="Task_ReorderFastest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">anySinglePartStockBelow3</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Below3_No" sourceRef="Gateway_Below3" targetRef="Gateway_ZeroMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReorderFastest_ZeroMerge" sourceRef="Task_ReorderFastest" targetRef="Gateway_ZeroMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ZeroMerge_Zero" sourceRef="Gateway_ZeroMerge" targetRef="Gateway_Zero"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Zero_Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Zero" targetRef="Task_ComplainByEmail">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">anySinglePartStockIsZero</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Zero_No" sourceRef="Gateway_Zero" targetRef="Event_LaterBatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Email_End" sourceRef="Task_ComplainByEmail" targetRef="End_ComplaintSent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LaterBatch_Build" sourceRef="Event_LaterBatch" targetRef="Task_BuildUseParts"/>

    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="Annotation_BatchTiming">
      <bpmn:text>Parts arrive in batches in a random order, typically about 2 days earlier or later than expected.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_FirstBatch_Timing" sourceRef="Annotation_BatchTiming" targetRef="Event_FirstBatch"/>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_LaterBatch_Timing" sourceRef="Annotation_BatchTiming" targetRef="Event_LaterBatch"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Contract">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Contract" name="Contract project" processRef="Process_Contract"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_WebShops" name="Web shops"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="Friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Query" name="Shop inquiry" sourceRef="Task_QueryShops" targetRef="Participant_WebShops" messageRef="Message_ShopInquiry"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ShopInformation" name="Availability, quantities, prices, and delivery times" sourceRef="Participant_WebShops" targetRef="Task_ReceiveShopInfo" messageRef="Message_ShopInformation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_InitialOrder" name="Parts orders" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrders" targetRef="Participant_WebShops" messageRef="Message_PartsOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FirstBatch" name="First parts batch" sourceRef="Participant_WebShops" targetRef="Event_FirstBatch" messageRef="Message_PartsBatch"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CheapestReorder" name="Cheapest-shop reorder" sourceRef="Task_ReorderCheapest" targetRef="Participant_WebShops" messageRef="Message_PartsOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FastestReorder" name="Fastest-shop reorder" sourceRef="Task_ReorderFastest" targetRef="Participant_WebShops" messageRef="Message_PartsOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_LaterBatch" name="Another parts batch" sourceRef="Participant_WebShops" targetRef="Event_LaterBatch" messageRef="Message_PartsBatch"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FriendEmail" name="Complaint email" sourceRef="Task_ComplainByEmail" targetRef="Participant_Friends" messageRef="Message_FriendEmail"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
